name: Quartr
description: Access structured first-party IR data from over 14,500+ public companies across 65 markets. Quartr delivers live and recorded earnings calls, real-time and historical transcripts with speaker identification, slide presentations, filings, reports, and event summaries. Best-in-class reliability and timeliness. Ideal for financial research, investment analysis, and building data-driven workflows on top of institutional-grade public company data.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Quartr to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Quartr to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.quartr.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Quartr MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Quartr lists 38 MCP tools, including search_companies, get_company, list_companies, list_related_companies, list_events, get_event, list_event_types, list_documents, read_document, read_live_transcript, search_documents, and get_financials.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Quartr?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Quartr in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Quartr requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Quartr is developed by Quartr. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
